PLA.notes: Default. Indoor, rigid, creeps under load or heat (>50C).

PETG.notes: Tougher, mild heat/UV. Good for enclosures and outdoor-ish parts.

ASA.notes: Outdoor/UV, heat to ~90C. Enclosed chamber helps; expect slight shrink.

ABS.notes: Heat-resistant, warps. Prefer ASA for outdoor.

TPU.notes: Flexible. Avoid tight tolerances and long bridges.

PETG-CF.notes: Stiff functional parts. Hardened nozzle required.

_note: Heat-set dimensions assume common tapered brass inserts (e.g. Ruthex-style). Measure yours and edit. Print a tolerance test first and update clearances_mm with measured results.
